newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X says still reviewing Placer plan.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X says still reviewing Placer plan.

text.p: Bre-X Minerals Ltd said on Friday it is still reviewing the US$5 billion merger proposal from Vancouver gold concern Placer Dome Inc.
In a statement, Bre-X chairman, president and chief executive David Walsh also confirmed an earlier statement from a company spokesman.

Both Walsh and the spokesman said Bre-X had not yet received a letter from the Indonesian government responding to a submission from Bre-X and Barrick Gold Corp on a joint venture to develop the massive Busang gold property.
Indonesian Mines and Energy Ministry Secretary-General Umar Said told Reuters earlier on Friday that the ministry responded today to the submission from Barrick and Bre-X.

"Bre-X Minerals Ltd. has not as yet received a letter that has purportedly been sent to it and Barrick Gold Corp. When we receive an official communication from the appropriate Indonesian government officials, we will carefully review it and promptly respond," Walsh said in the statement.
"In the meantime, we are also continuing to review the merger proposition we have received from Placer Dome," he added.
Placer said Friday morning it was still hopeful that its bid to merge with Bre-X will find favor with the Indonesian government despite a report to the contrary.
A source in the Indonesian mines ministry told Reuters in Jakarta that the government was not likely to accept Placer's involvement in development of the deposit.
